title: triticum monococcum var. lasiorrhachis
intro: Triticum monococcum var. lasiorrhachis, commonly known as wild einkorn, is a type of ancient grain that belongs to the wheat family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Triticum monococcum var. lasiorrhachis include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and other compounds that are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
